established_by: MES-234 (PO YES on fix D and the dated G30 limb; PM rulings 35494, 35498)
what_this_is: The pinned set of crosswalk edges whose `evidence` is a DATED lift: the tree moved under them after they were measured, and they were not re-measured. Each one names the commit its evidence describes in `evidence_at`, and G30 reads its ET windows at that commit and never at the tip. The cells stay what they were measured as; the date says so.
why_these: The SDK behaviour under these edges changed in MES-161 and MES-165, so their quotes are no longer at the tip, and re-lifting them at the tip would make the evidence contradict the recorded verdicts, whose OC side is the accepted run. Re-measuring them is the owner ticket's scope.
ceiling_rule: The ceiling only goes DOWN. G30 refuses, by name, a ceiling above the one compiled into MCP.Conformance.Crosswalk.dated_ceiling/0, more pins than the ceiling, more records carrying evidence_at than the ceiling, a dated record that is not pinned here (or is pinned at another commit or owner), a dated record with no owner, and a pin that no dated record uses. The owner ticket removes a pin when it re-measures the edge, and lowers the ceiling with it.
